# The Atlantic

> A leading American magazine and digital publication offering in-depth journalism on politics, culture, technology, science, and global affairs.

The Atlantic provides comprehensive coverage across news, opinion, and long-form journalism, with a focus on political analysis, cultural criticism, and emerging technologies like AI. The publication reaches audiences through its website, newsletters, and special editorial projects.

## Key Topics

- Politics & Elections
- Trump Administration
- Geopolitics & International Affairs
- Technology & AI
- Climate & Environment
- Culture & Entertainment
- Economics & Jobs
- Health & Science
- Opinion Essays
- Long-Form Journalism
- Featured Articles
- News Analysis
- Magazine Coverage

## Core Navigation

- [The Atlantic Homepage](https://www.theatlantic.com): The Atlantic homepage featuring news, politics, culture, and opinion
- [Latest Articles](https://www.theatlantic.com/latest): Latest news and articles from The Atlantic
- [Most Popular](https://www.theatlantic.com/most-popular): Most popular stories from The Atlantic across all topics
- [Special Projects](https://www.theatlantic.com/projects): Special editorial collections and long-form journalism projects
- [Newsletters](https://www.theatlantic.com/newsletters): Email newsletter subscriptions for The Atlantic content

## Politics & Government

- [Politics](https://www.theatlantic.com/politics): The Atlantic's U.S. politics coverage and analysis
- [Ideas](https://www.theatlantic.com/ideas): Opinion essays and political commentary from The Atlantic
- [Global Affairs](https://www.theatlantic.com/international): International news and geopolitical analysis

## Technology, Science & Environment

- [Technology](https://www.theatlantic.com/technology): Technology coverage including AI, ChatGPT, and tech industry
- [Science](https://www.theatlantic.com/science): Science and environmental reporting from The Atlantic
- [Planet](https://www.theatlantic.com/projects/planet): Climate change and environmental coverage from The Atlantic
- [Health](https://www.theatlantic.com/health): Health and medical news coverage from The Atlantic

## Culture & Society

- [Culture](https://www.theatlantic.com/culture): Culture and entertainment coverage including film and TV
- [Books](https://www.theatlantic.com/books): Book reviews and literary criticism from The Atlantic
- [Photography](https://www.theatlantic.com/photo): Photography galleries and visual storytelling from The Atlantic
- [Family](https://www.theatlantic.com/family): Relationships and family coverage from The Atlantic

## Economics & Work

- [Economy](https://www.theatlantic.com/economy): Economic news, trade policy, and financial coverage
- [Work In Progress](https://www.theatlantic.com/progress): Economics, jobs, and workplace coverage from The Atlantic

## Education & Learning

- [Education](https://www.theatlantic.com/education): Education policy and university coverage
